description: Propose an exact replacement for a piece of text on the page — a copy or grammar fix — as a diff the human can accept, rather than a comment describing the change in prose. `rects` are the on-page bounding boxes of `text`, in document pixels: one per line it spans, so a wrapped sentence highlights as several boxes rather than one box swallowing the whole paragraph between its first and last line. Pass selector + tag + markdown together to anchor it to the containing element so it re-resolves if the page reflows.

comment.description: Optional note explaining the fix, if it is not self-evident.

markdown.description: Short markdown snapshot of the element, for the human to see.

priority.description: Triage priority, if this warrants one.

rects.description: Document-pixel bounding box(es) of `text` on the page — one per line it spans.

selector.description: CSS selector of the element containing this text.

tag.description: Tag name of that element, e.g. "p".

text.description: The exact text on the page being replaced.

name: marklayer_suggest_edit
